correctness.rationale: For uniform VOLUME measure on each centered solid, tetrahedron/cube/octahedron have quartic polynomial Q(u)=qΣu_i^4+6pΣ_{i<j}u_i²u_j². Dirichlet integration yields (q,p,R4)=(3/35,1/21,19/35),(1/5,1/9,19/15),(1/35,1/210,4/35), giving η=5(q−3p)/R4=−10/19,−10/19,5/8. For each solid, decomposition into centered face pyramids gives κ=25/21[1+β²(8+4c+3c²)/(180B²)], B=1−β+β(2+c)/6; exact Platonic c,β yield κ values 95/63,19/15,80/63,(338875−37475√5)/211722,(185−15√5)/126. The rotational icosahedral character of harmonic degrees 2 and 4 has zero fixed multiplicity, proving η=0 for dodecahedron/icosahedron. Independent exact SymPy reductions reproduced every κ and the first three η. The source verify.py was actually read: exact symbolic face, Dirichlet, character calculations and supplementary Monte Carlo (not proof). Scope is filled volume, not vertices/surface.
